# Seafin

> Seafin LLC (Oceanside, California) is an AI consulting firm for small and mid-sized US businesses that have no AI team. Seafin finds where AI pays off, sets up Claude or ChatGPT for teams, builds apps and agent workflows into the tools a business already uses, and keeps them running. The work runs in four steps: Find, Build, Secure and deploy, Run. A person approves the result wherever it matters. Clients own what is built for them.

## Services and prices
- Strategy Audit: $499 for up to 25 people, $999 for 26 to 100; over 100 people, quoted after the free call; about one week. A short form for you and two or three staff, a 3-hour working session with the people who do the work, a written report with the top three AI opportunities, estimated savings and a 90-day plan, then a 1-hour review. For 26 to 100 people: each department manager fills in a 15-minute questionnaire, then a 45-minute call with the managers of the 3 departments with the most hours at stake; 7 to 10 days. You don't pay unless it finds at least 3 opportunities, each worth more than the fee a year; the fee comes off a build started within 90 days.
- Set up Claude or ChatGPT for your team: $1,500 for up to 10 people, $2,500 for 11 to 25, about a week, done remotely.
- Custom Builds: most cost $3,000 to $15,000; fixed price agreed after the audit, typically 2 to 6 weeks. Apps that replace fragmented software, agent workflows on Claude or ChatGPT, and assistants that answer from company files. Deployed on the client's server, in the office or in their cloud account, with sign-in through Entra ID, Active Directory or Google, and security testing on everything Seafin builds.
- Managed AI: from $500 a month, month to month; same-business-day replies.
- Microsoft 365 and Azure Automation: workflow automation for businesses on Microsoft 365, Entra ID and Azure. New hires, role changes and leavers handled in Entra ID (accounts, licenses by role, Teams and SharePoint access, same-day sign-out for leavers); Teams and SharePoint workspaces created from a template with expiring guest access; approvals in Power Automate; invoices, forms and shared-inbox email read by Claude or ChatGPT and filed or entered, with unclear items sent to a person; Logic Apps and Azure Functions connecting Microsoft 365 to accounting, CRM and other software; Claude through Microsoft Foundry or OpenAI models through Azure OpenAI inside the client's Azure account; Azure Automation runbooks; Intune and Autopilot laptop setup; Azure Virtual Desktop; moves off old servers; a $750 Azure cost audit. Most projects $1,500 to $6,000 at a fixed price. Built in the client's own tenant; the client owns every flow and script; works alongside the client's IT person or company.

## What Seafin builds
Phone agents that book jobs; invoice and contract audits that find overcharges; AI that uses websites and portals with no other way in; turning photos and paper into data; overnight work with a spending cap; apps that replace fragmented software; websites with AI built in; documents into accounting systems and CRMs.

## Where it runs
Directly through Anthropic (Claude) or OpenAI business accounts, or inside the client's own Amazon, Microsoft or Google cloud account for compliance needs such as HIPAA.
